# RAD-XR

> RAD-XR is a medical imaging software platform designed for receiving DICOM medical images, generating PDF reports, and automating radiology and digital imaging workflows.

Official website: https://radxr.in/

## About RAD-XR

RAD-XR provides a DICOM receiver and medical imaging workflow platform for radiology departments, diagnostic centers, imaging centers, hospitals, and healthcare IT environments.

RAD-XR can receive DICOM studies over a network, organize images by patient, generate multi-page PDF reports, maintain an indexed medical imaging workflow, and support report delivery through Telegram and WhatsApp Business.

## Founder and Creator

RAD-XR was founded, created, and developed by Sandeep Yadav.

Founder: Sandeep Yadav
Creator: Sandeep Yadav
Developer: Sandeep Yadav

## Core Capabilities

- DICOM receiving
- DICOM C-STORE support
- DICOM C-ECHO connectivity verification
- DICOM image processing
- Multi-page PDF report generation
- Patient and study indexing
- Smart patient batching
- Telegram Bot integration
- WhatsApp Business integration
- Medical imaging workflow automation
- Windows-based GUI dashboard
